    20→        val dependencyId = getDependencyId(documents)
    21→        val dependency = proxyApplicationService.fetchDependencies(dependencyId)
    22→
    23→        return documents.map {
    24→            // Note. Product는 brand, manufacturer 매핑이 없을 수 있다. Category는 현재 룰기반(레거시) 매핑을 사용한다.
    25→            if (it.op == Operation.CREATE) {
    26→                require(it.afterData != null) {
    27→                    "Failed to assemble product. afterData must not be null for create operation"
    28→                }
    29→                require(dependency.categories[it.afterData!!.categoryId] != null) {
    30→                    "Failed to assemble product. Category must not be null. productId=[${it.afterData!!.id}]"
    31→                }
    32→            }
    33→
    34→            it.toIndexDocument(
    35→                category = dependency.categories[it.afterData?.categoryId],
    36→                brand = dependency.brands[it.afterData?.brandId],
    37→                manufacturer = dependency.manufacturers[it.afterData?.manufacturerId],
    38→            )
    39→        }
    40→    }

    44→        val brandIds: MutableList<Long> = mutableListOf()
    45→        val manufacturerIds: MutableList<Long> = mutableListOf()
    46→        val mallIds: MutableList<Int> = mutableListOf()
